question.problem: Let $A$ be a $m\times n$ matrix. What is the image of ${R}^{m}$ under the action of ${A}^{T}?$
question.worked_solution:
First, notice that ${A}^{T}$ is a $n\times m$ matrix.

Pre-multiplying a vector $x\in {R}^{m}$ by ${A}^{T}$ gives a linear combination of the columns of ${A}^{T}:$

$$
{{[\begin{aligned}| & | & ⋯ & | \\ {a}_{1}^{T} & {a}_{2}^{T} & ⋯ & {a}_{m}^{T} \\ | & | & ⋯ & |\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{A}^{T}}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ ⋮ \\ {x}_{m}\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{x}={x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}| \\ {a}_{1}^{T} \\ |\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}| \\ {a}_{2}^{T} \\ |\end{aligned}]+⋯+{x}_{m}[\begin{aligned}| \\ {a}_{m}^{T} \\ |\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, the image of ${R}^{m}$ under the action of ${A}^{T}$ must be $\text{Col}({A}^{T}),$ the row space of $A.$
